title: Add plural resource quests_waiting_body
description: Add the plural resource used to localize the daily unfinished-quests reminder body ("You have %1$d quest waiting. Don't let the loot slip away!" / "You have %1$d quests waiting. Don't let the loot slip away!").
acceptance_criteria: app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml gains a <plurals name="quests_waiting_body"> with "one" item "You have %1$d quest waiting. Don\'t let the loot slip away!" and "other" item "You have %1$d quests waiting. Don\'t let the loot slip away!"
exact_code:
<plurals name="quests_waiting_body">
        <item quantity="one">You have %1$d quest waiting. Don\'t let the loot slip away!</item>
        <item quantity="other">You have %1$d quests waiting. Don\'t let the loot slip away!</item>
    </plurals>
